rawText: Found 48 items in registries @velobits: Showing items 1-48 of 48: - velobits (registry:style) - The base style: tokens, the cn util, the provider stack, and every Tier-1 primitive, Tier-2 overlay and Tier-3 composite. Start here. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - velobits-theme (registry:theme) - The full token layer as CSS variables. Every colour pair here is contrast-verified in both themes by the @velobitsio/tokens test suite. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - cn (registry:lib) - Tailwind-aware class merger. Signature must stay twMerge(clsx(...)) , the dashboard app points components.json `utils` at it. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - theme (registry:lib) - React-free light/dark resolution, storage and the blocking init script. Storage key is required, never defaulted. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - use-theme (registry:hook) - ThemeProvider + useTheme. Honours the existing fmx_theme_mode and tf.theme keys. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - use-media-query (registry:hook) - Media query subscription plus usePrefersReducedMotion. Import breakpoints from @velobitsio/tokens rather than re-typing the pixel value, so the JS and CSS breakpoints cannot drift apart. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - use-row-selection (registry:hook) - Row selection for DataTable. The selection is DERIVED , the stored set intersected with the rows on screen , so a bulk action can never point at a row the filter has hidden. Returns a stable object identity, which is what keeps DataTable’s memoised rows from re-rendering per keystroke. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - velobits-provider (registry:ui) - Mount once at the shell root: ThemeProvider + TooltipProvider + MotionConfig reducedMotion="user". [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - alert (registry:ui) - Status panel. Defaults to polite role="status"; escalate to "alert" deliberately. Tier-S glass on the neutral variant only , the four soft washes would replace the tint. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - avatar (registry:ui) [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - badge (registry:ui) - Soft washes pair with the matching text token, never with the solid fill. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - button (registry:ui) - Controls are radius-md. No variant paints --primary as text; `link` uses --primary-text. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - card (registry:ui) - Tier-S glass by default; surface="panel" for the opaque original, which writes border-border explicitly so it survives an app that skipped the base layer. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - checkbox (registry:ui) - Includes the indeterminate state bulk-selection headers need. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - field (registry:ui) - Label/description/error wiring. Keeps BOTH ids in aria-describedby when a field has an error and a hint. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - glass-surface (registry:ui) - All three glass tiers behind one prop: surface (Tier S, no blur by default) · overlay · elevated. Never for page backgrounds, table rows, or nested glass. [@velobits] Add command: `[object Promise]` - input (registry:ui) - border-input maps to --field-border, the half WCAG 1.4.11 gates.
